speaker: Doctor
text:
I am Dr. Agent. Given your symptoms of fatigue, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes, I need to know if you have experienced any recent infections, travel, or contact with anyone diagnosed with tuberculosis or lymphoma. Additionally, please tell me if you have noticed any skin changes, lumps elsewhere, or changes in your bowel movements.

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, ESR, CRP
REQUEST TEST: LDH and Ferritin
REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the results; since your blood work and chest X-ray are normal, I need to determine if the lymph nodes are tender, have been present for more than a month, or if you have any history of alcohol consumption. Also, have you noticed any unexplained bruising, bleeding, or specific skin rashes like a "peau d'orange" texture?

REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Smear
REQUEST IMAGES: Ultrasound_Supraclavicular_Node

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your blood work, chest X-ray, peripheral smear, and ultrasound of the supraclavicular node are all normal, I need to clarify the timeline and systemic nature of your symptoms. Have you noticed any fever spikes, specifically morning fevers, or any changes in your appetite beyond the weight loss? Additionally, does the abdominal pain localize to a specific quadrant, and have you had any recent dental procedures or gum disease?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Occult malignancy or systemic inflammatory condition requiring further investigation; immediate CT scan of abdomen and pelvis is indicated.
